# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 26 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** The Book's Conclusion — An Invitation to the Reader

---

**26:1** This is the book of the conversion of Aseneth and her life with Joseph.

**26:2** All who read it and take it to heart will be blessed, for in it is written the way of those who turn to the living God.

**26:3** And it is written for the instruction of all who wish to turn from idols to the worship of the Most High God.

**26:4** Let those who read give thanks to God, who is the giver of all good things, and to his servant Joseph, through whom the nations were fed.

**26:5** And let them also give thanks for Aseneth, who was exalted from among the nations and placed among the chosen people of God.

**26:6** Glory be to God who works such wonders for those who love him and take refuge in him.

---
*EMET: hyphenated compounds; chapter:verse format.*
